subject: Credit request: trial overage & accounting treatment
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@acme.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jared Cole <jared.cole@acme.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: trial overage credit and billing question

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team at Acme started the trial on 3/01 and we pushed a larger ingestion test last week that spiked usage. We received the invoice for the overage (attached) and it shows a $2,100 charge for token overages. Can Redwood issue a credit memo or apply an invoice offset?

Quick details:
- Subscription ID: ACME-2026-77
- Invoice: INV-20260324-ACME (attached)
- Trial period: 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-30

We'd prefer an invoice offset so our AR team can close the month without a manual adjustment. If you need any further documentation please let me know.

Thanks,
Maya Singh
Finance Manager, Acme Systems
maya.singh@acme.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: acme_invoice_20260324.pdf
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: trial overage credit and billing question

Hi Maya — thanks for the note and the invoice. Appreciate the heads-up.

I've looped in Neha from Finance to confirm the recommended accounting treatment and whether we should do an invoice offset versus a standalone credit memo. My initial preference is to apply a one-time invoice offset of $2,100 to INV-20260324-ACME and to extend your trial by 30 days so your team has time to finish evaluation without extra charges.

Neha / Rachel — could you confirm:
- Is an invoice offset acceptable here from a revenue recognition and tax perspective?
- If we issue a credit memo, which GL account should we map the adjustment to (suggestions below)?

Suggested GL options for discussion:
- 4002 — Revenue adjustments (contra-revenue)
- 2201 — Customer credits / AR allowances

I've attached a draft credit memo for Finance to review.

Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Attachment: draft_credit_memo_345.xlsx
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Maya Singh <maya.singh@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Mar 2026 08:49:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: trial overage credit and billing question

Thanks Marcus — I reviewed the invoice and the suggested offset. A couple of accounting items we need to confirm before applying anything: 

1) Amount confirmation: Please confirm that $2,100 is the agreed net credit (i.e., after any taxes). If sales wants to absorb tax, we need to record tax adjustments separately.

2) Policy & GL mapping: Per SOP FIN-043 for promotional/trial adjustments, our standard treatment for trial-related credits is to post to contra-revenue (GL 4002) unless the credit is an AR allowance tied to satisfaction/collections (then GL 2201). For audits, contra-revenue gives clearer visibility into marketing/promotional adjustments.

3) Documentation: I need the following attached to the accounting ticket: final approved credit memo (PDF), HubSpot deal record, and a one-line rationale (e.g., "Trial extension + trial overage credit — agreed during POE call 3/22").

I've created a Jira ticket for Accounting Ops: JIRA-ACCT-1823. Once Rachel signs off we can move to post the offset and generate the credit memo number.

Please confirm amount and whether tax is included.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Finance Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya.singh@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Mar 2026 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: trial overage credit and billing question

Thanks — I reviewed and authorize the adjustment.

Decision:
- Apply an invoice offset of $2,100 to INV-20260324-ACME (do not issue a standalone cash refund).
- Map the adjustment to GL 4002 (contra-revenue) and include promo code TRIALEX23 on the memo for tracking.
- Tax: Acme confirmed the invoice line is net of tax; Finance should confirm with Tax Ops, but proceed assuming no tax liability for Redwood.

Neha: please proceed with JIRA-ACCT-1823 and attach the final credit memo PDF. Marcus: confirm with Maya that the trial will be extended 30 days and that the offset will appear on her next statement.

Rachel Kim
Director, Revenue Operations
rachel.kim@redwood.ai

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
